title: KOB token registry
description: Pinned token programs and the tokens KOB knows about. Structure only: cross-field rules (family/template agreement, extension commitment rules, duplicate identities, confusable tickers, listing prerequisites, slot-limit consistency) are enforced by kob_protocol::registry::Registry::validate.

review_status.description: only reviewed templates are on the strict list: a token on one of them is tradable

escrow.description: kcc20: owner_scheme 4 and borrow_scheme 0. kron: id_type 2, is_minter 0, delivery_id_type 3 or 0.

capabilities.description: what the program's authorities can do beyond owner-authorised transfers; freeze, seize and blacklist are labelled in every UI. Optional, default none

risks.description: declared risks of the program that are not a capability (missing hardening, signing assumptions); shown next to the capabilities. Optional, default none

warning_code.description: token warning codes of the API data model (kob_protocol::registry::TokenWarning, the executor's /v1/tokens `warnings`). Derived, not stored in this file: genesis_unverified = the entry does not say genesis_verified: true (every open-list token without an entry carries it)

genesis_record.description: what the genesis check (C1) and the live-mint-authority check (C2) found, re-derived from registry/evidence/ by kob registry verify-genesis. Needs genesis_verified. Optional

txid.description: genesis transaction id (recomputed from the recorded transaction)

daa_score.description: DAA score of the block that accepted the genesis

outputs.description: output indices of the genesis group, strictly increasing

minter_outputs.description: genesis outputs carrying a mint authority (KRON is_minter != 0); empty proves a KRON token never has a live minter

live_minters.description: live mint-authority cells (txid:index): [] = none (C2 holds), absent = not determined; non-empty needs a warning and forbids official

checked_at_daa.description: virtual DAA score of the node the check read liveness from

source.description: where the bytes came from (node, explorer, issuer) and how they were checked

extension_commitment.description: required for kcc20, null for kron

lot_size.description: legacy (protocol v2 lots): read and ignored; protocol v3 orders have no lot

tick.description: legacy (protocol v2 price tick): read and ignored

verified.description: KOB checked covenant id and template hash against chain

genesis_verified.description: Genesis check: true = EVERY output of the token's genesis group was revealed and is an instance of its program (kob_protocol::registry::verify_genesis); false = checked and NOT clean; absent = not checked. Needs verified; official needs true; without true the API attaches the warning genesis_unverified. Optional

warning.description: free-text warning UIs show next to the token (e.g. what the genesis check found). Optional

official.description: confirmed genuine (shown with an official badge); needs verified, genesis_verified, a genesis record with live_minters [] (no live mint authority) and status listed. Optional, default false (shown as unverified)
